title: The Most Unsettling Books We Know - Nautilus
gist: Nautilus's Halloween feature offers twelve unsettling books recommended by scientists and artists, covering fear from deep space and time, technological and natural existential risk, and ideas that upend assumptions about reality.

insights.claim: Existential risks from technology and nature, and the depths of space and time, can unsettle readers as effectively as classic horror, according to Nautilus.
insights.speaker: Namir Khaliq
insights.so_what: Cultural appetite for existential-risk themes persists in popular science media.
insights.locator: There's no shortage of ways to unsettle yourself

insights.claim: Nautilus is presenting a dozen book recommendations from scientific and artistic luminaries for Halloween, each said to inspire both wonder and terror.
insights.speaker: Namir Khaliq
insights.so_what: Light editorial content; little investable signal.
insights.locator: This Halloween, we offer you a dozen books
